23475-the-works-of-lord-byron-vol-5-poet.title: The Works Of Lord Byron Vol 5 Poetry
23475-the-works-of-lord-byron-vol-5-poet.creator: Unknown
23475-the-works-of-lord-byron-vol-5-poet.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The plays and poems contained in this volume were written within the space of two years--the last two years of Byron's career as a poet. of _Don Juan_, _The Vision of Judgment_, _The Blues_, _The Irish Avatar_, and other minor poems, belong to the same period. The end was near, and, as though he had received a warning, he hastened to make the roll complete.

arxiv-2109-05244.title: Modeling Concentrated Cross-Attention for Neural Machine Translation with Gaussian Mixture Model
arxiv-2109-05244.creator: Shaolei Zhang, Yang Feng
arxiv-2109-05244.description: Abstract Cross-attention is an important component of neural machine translation (NMT), which is always realized by dot-product attention in previous methods. However, dot-product attention only considers the pair-wise correlation between words, resulting in dispersion when dealing with long sentences and neglect of source neighboring relationships.

arxiv-2201-04132.title: The dipolar Bose-Hubbard model
arxiv-2201-04132.creator: Ethan Lake, Michael Hermele, T. Senthil
arxiv-2201-04132.description: Abstract We study a simple model of interacting bosons on a d d -dimensional cubic lattice whose dynamics conserves both total boson number and total boson dipole moment. This model provides a simple framework in which several remarkable consequences of dipole conservation can be explored.

arxiv-2205-10560.title: Unsupervised Sign Language Phoneme Clustering using HamNoSys Notation
arxiv-2205-10560.creator: Boris Mocialov, Graham Turner, Helen Hastie
arxiv-2205-10560.description: Abstract Traditionally, sign language resources have been collected in controlled settings for specific tasks involving supervised sign classification or linguistic studies accompanied by specific annotation type. To date, very few who explored signing videos found online on social media platforms as well as the use of unsupervised methods applied to such resources.

arxiv-2205-13068.title: Tight Lower Bounds on Worst-Case Guarantees for Zero-Shot Learning with Attributes
arxiv-2205-13068.creator: Alessio MazzettoBrown University, Cristina MenghiniBrown UniversityAndrew YuanBrown UniversityEli UpfalBrown UniversityStephen H. BachBrown University
arxiv-2205-13068.description: Abstract We develop a rigorous mathematical analysis of zero-shot learning with attributes. In this setting, the goal is to label novel classes with no training data, only detectors for attributes and a description of how those attributes are correlated with the target classes, called the class-attribute matrix.

arxiv-2206-14952.title: Locating the GeV Emission Region in the Jets of Blazars from Months-Timescale Multi-Wavelength Outbursts 2022
arxiv-2206-14952.creator: Saugata Barat, Ritaban Chatterjee, Kaustav Mitra
arxiv-2206-14952.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Saugata Barat, Ritaban Chatterjee, Kaustav Mitra. It is well-known that the γ \gamma -ray emission in blazars originate in the relativistic jet pointed at the observers. However, it is not clear whether the exact location of the GeV emission is less than a pc from the central engine, such that it may receive sufficient amount of photons from the broad line region (BLR) or farther out at 1-100 pc range.

arxiv-2311-15525.title: Overview of the VLSP 2022 - Abmusu Shared Task: A Data Challenge for Vietnamese Abstractive Multi-document Summarization
arxiv-2311-15525.creator: Mai-Vu Tran, Hoang-Quynh Le, Duy-Cat Can, Quoc-An Nguyen VNU University of Engineering and Technology, Hanoi, Vietnam. {vutm, lhquynh, catcd, annq}@vnu.edu.vn
arxiv-2311-15525.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mai-Vu Tran, Hoang-Quynh Le, Duy-Cat Can, Quoc-An Nguyen VNU University of Engineering and Technology, Hanoi, Vietnam. {vutm, lhquynh, catcd, annq}@vnu.edu.vn. This paper reports the overview of the VLSP 2022 - Vietnamese abstractive multi-document summarization (Abmusu) shared task for Vietnamese News. This task is hosted at the 9 th annual workshop on Vietnamese Language and Speech Processing (VLSP 2022). The goal of Abmusu shared task is to develop summarization systems that could create abstractive summaries automatically for a set of documents on a topic.

arxiv-2406-00234.title: Learning to Stabilize Unknown LTI Systems on a Single Trajectory under Stochastic Noise
arxiv-2406-00234.creator: Ziyi Zhang, Yorie Nakahira, Guannan Qu
arxiv-2406-00234.description: Abstract We study the problem of learning to stabilize unknown noisy Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) systems on a single trajectory. It is well known in the literature that the learn-to-stabilize problem suffers from exponential blow-up in which the state norm blows up in the order of Θ ⁡ ( 2 n ) \Theta(2^{n}) where n n is the state space dimension.

arxiv-2412-13314.title: Distributed Speculative Execution for Resilient Cloud Applications
arxiv-2412-13314.creator: Tianyu Li, Badrish Chandramouli, Philip A. Bernstein, Samuel Madden
arxiv-2412-13314.description: Abstract Fault-tolerance is critically important in highly-distributed modern cloud applications. Solutions such as Temporal, Azure Durable Functions, and Beldi hide fault-tolerance complexity from developers by persisting execution state and resuming seamlessly from persisted state after failure. This pattern, often called durable execution , usually forces frequent and synchronous persistence and results in hefty latency overheads.

arxiv-2512-06102.title: JaxWildfire – A GPU-Accelerated Wildfire Simulator for Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2512-06102.creator: Ufuk Çakır, Victor-Alexandru Darvariu, Bruno Lacerda, Nick Hawes
arxiv-2512-06102.description: Abstract Artificial intelligence methods are increasingly being explored for managing wildfires and other natural hazards. In particular, reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising path towards improving outcomes in such uncertain decision-making scenarios and moving beyond reactive strategies. However, training RL agents requires many environment interactions, and the speed of existing wildfire simulators is a severely limiting factor.

pmc-10558678.creator: Gauri Adhikari, Suson Ghimire, Gopal Adhikari, Krishnaraj Aryal, Narayan Kandel
pmc-10558678.description: Key Clinical MessageSubarachnoid block with local anesthetic agents is a well‐established anesthesia technique among pregnant females for labor analgesia and cesarian delivery. pmc-11474704.creator: Azadeh Wickham, Cynthia L Russell, John M Gatti
pmc-11474704.description: IntroductionClean intermittent catheterisation (CIC) is the standard of care for treating neurogenic lower urinary tract dysfunction (NLUTD), the most common bladder dysfunction in children diagnosed with spinal dysraphism (SD) and spinal cord injury (SCI). Failure to follow the prescribed CIC regimen results in urinary tract infections, incontinence and renal insufficiency.

pmc-11516585.title: How can we measure labour exploitation and develop interventions to protect migrant workers’ health? Insights from intervention-focused research on cattle ranching in Brazil and child domestic work in Liberia and Nigeria
pmc-11516585.creator: C Zimmerman, E Keaveny
pmc-11516585.description: Much of our food and services rely on the work of migrants, which is often carried out under exploitative terms. Exploitative work results in work-related injuries and illnesses and mental ill-health. Yet, the global health community has been negligent in detecting migrant workers in the general population, and in measuring the effects of their work terms on their health.

pmc-12607817.title: Analysis of the Reasons for Poor Prognosis in Severe to Profound Sudden Sensorineural Hearing Loss: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12607817.creator: Linrui Chen, Jianhui Qiu, Qianqian Zhang, Zian Xi, Qiong Wu, Mingwei Xu, Qin Zhang, Yulian Jin, Jun Yang, Maoli Duan, Qing Zhang, Zhiyuan Zhang, Zahra Jafari
pmc-12607817.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Objectives: Patients with severe to profound sudden sensorineural hearing loss (SSNHL) generally experience poorer hearing recovery; however, the associated risk factors have not been identified. This study synthesizes current evidence to explore prognostic risk factors in this patient group. Methods: Databases were systematically searched through PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library, from their inception to 18 October 2025. Three researchers independently extracted and recorded patient information and relevant data from all selected studies.

pmc-12676457.title: Relative testis size is associated with vagina length but not sperm storage traits in Galliformes
pmc-12676457.creator: Katherine Assersohn, Nicola Hemmings
pmc-12676457.description: Post-copulatory sexual selection, comprised of sperm competition and cryptic female choice, is a powerful evolutionary force that can drive the rapid diversification of reproductive traits across taxa. In birds, the female reproductive tract provides the arena for post-copulatory sexual selection, yet we lack a comprehensive understanding of the female specific processes that shape the evolution of sexually selected traits.

pmc-12982666.creator: Wolfgang P. Ruf, Julia K. Kühlwein, Laura Meier, Sarah J. Brockmann, Jaehyun LeeBae, Ghazaleh Sadri-Vakili, Deniz Yilmazer-Hanke, Susanne Petri, Dietmar R. Thal, Veselin Grozdanov, Karin M. Danzer
pmc-12982666.description: Cytoplasmic TDP-43 pathology is a pathological sign of ALS/ALS-FTD and a converging disease event across different genotypes, phenotypes and CNS areas. To understand this process and target it therapeutically, we need to define which cell types are affected and which cell-type specific effects make them particularly vulnerable.

pmc-13443029.title: Healthcare Inequity in Spinal Cord Injury: Out of Pocket and Access Barriers in Paraplegic and Tetraplegic Patients in Iran
pmc-13443029.creator: Ali Alavi-Badabsari, Alireza Ahmadi-veshno, Seyyed Pouyan Zadparast, Delaram Fadaee Heydarabadi, Enayatollah Homaie Rad
pmc-13443029.description: ObjectiveSpinal cord injury (SCI) imposes substantial long-term physical, psychological, as well as financial burdens on patients in Iran, where high out-of-pocket (OOP) payments remain a major barrier to care. This study examined inequalities in healthcare utilization and OOP expenditures among patients with paraplegia and tetraplegia.

pmc-13534338.title: Efficient and Stable MA‐Free Sn─Pb Perovskite Solar Cells With Exceptional V OC by Bioavailable Phytophenol Sinapic Acid
pmc-13534338.creator: Seojun Lee, Padmini Pandey, Dong Gyu Lee, Tae‐Gyeong Lee, Saemon Yoon, Insub Noh, Sang Wook Park, Jun Ryu, SungWon Cho, Dong‐Gun Lee, Hyung Do Kim, Tae Kyung Lee, Dong‐Won Kang
pmc-13534338.description: Narrow‐bandgap Sn─Pb perovskite solar cells (PSCs) are vital for advancing high‐efficiency tandem photovoltaics and near‐infrared optoelectronic devices, yet their performance is limited by Sn2+ oxidation, defective crystallization, and instability, particularly in thermally stable methlyammonium (MA)‐free systems. We introduce a transformative approach using sinapic acid (SA), a bioavailable phytophenol, as a multifunctional additive to address these challenges in MA‐free Sn─Pb PSCs.

uslaw-usc-t22-s9711.title: 22 U.S.C. § 9711 — Humanitarian relief for the Venezuelan people
uslaw-usc-t22-s9711.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s9711.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 104 (Venezuela Assistance); Subchapter II (Humanitarian Relief For Venezuela). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Sense of Congress It is the sense of Congress that— (1) the United States Government should expand efforts to peacefully address Venezuela’s humanitarian crisis; and (2) humanitarian assistance— (A) should be targeted toward those most in need.
